streaming.title: Streaming Guide (SSE)
streaming.subtitle: Real-time AI responses with Server-Sent Events
streaming.overviewDesc: The streaming endpoint allows you to receive AI responses in real-time as they are generated, instead of waiting for the complete response. This is perfect for:
streaming.overviewItem1: ✅ Better UX - Users see immediate feedback
streaming.overviewItem2: ✅ Long responses - Progress indication for lengthy generations
streaming.overviewItem3: ✅ Reduced latency - Start processing results immediately
streaming.overviewItem4: ✅ Interactive applications - Chat interfaces, live editors
streaming.curlNote: Note: The -N flag disables buffering to see streaming output in real-time.
streaming.handleTimeoutsDesc: SSE connections can stay open for up to 1 hour. Implement reconnection logic:
streaming.bufferIncompleteDesc: Tokens may arrive mid-word. Buffer until you receive a complete sentence:
streaming.closeConnectionsDesc: Always close the EventSource when done:
streaming.importantItem1: Streaming uses more server resources - use only when needed
streaming.importantItem2: Rate limits still apply to streaming requests
streaming.importantItem4: For short responses, consider using /api/v1/ai/process instead
streaming.errorHandlingDesc: Errors are sent as RFC 7807 Problem Details:
streaming.performanceItem1: Bandwidth: Streaming may use more bandwidth due to event overhead
streaming.performanceItem2: Server Resources: Keeps connection open longer
streaming.performanceItem3: Client Processing: Requires handling partial responses
streaming.performanceItem4: Use Case: Best for responses > 200 tokens or interactive UIs
streaming.whenToUse: When to Use Streaming vs. Standard

multipart.title: Multipart File Upload
multipart.subtitle: Upload files directly without Base64 encoding
multipart.advantage1: Smaller size - no Base64 overhead (~33% savings)
multipart.advantage3: Simplicity - no need to convert to Base64
multipart.advantage4: Large files - up to 100 MB (vs 10 MB for Base64)
multipart.compatibilityDesc: API automatically detects format by Content-Type. Old clients with Base64 will continue to work without changes.
multipart.responseFormatDesc: Response is identical to JSON requests:
multipart.bestPractice1: Do NOT set Content-Type manually - let the library add the boundary
multipart.bestPractice4: Handle upload errors - network may be interrupted
multipart.bestPractice5: Show progress to user for large files
multipart.migrationImportant1: Base64 method is NOT removed - it remains for backward compatibility
multipart.migrationImportant2: Old clients will continue to work without changes
multipart.migrationImportant3: Multipart is recommended for new integrations
multipart.doNotSetContentType: Do NOT set Content-Type manually - browser will set it with boundary
multipart.doNotSetContentTypePython: Do NOT set Content-Type - requests will set it automatically

parameters.title: Model Parameters Guide
parameters.subtitle: Complete reference for all AI model parameters
parameters.noteDesc: All parameters are optional. Default values will be used if not specified.
parameters.commonParametersDesc: These parameters are supported by both Gemini and OpenAI models:
parameters.responseFormatImportantDesc: When using JSON mode, you MUST include the word "JSON" in your prompt. Example: "Return the response in JSON format."
parameters.logitBiasDesc: Increase likelihood of token 1234 by 50, decrease 5678 by 50:
parameters.unsupportedParameterNoteDesc: If you send a parameter not supported by the model, it will be ignored (no error).
parameters.tipsTempDesc: Start with 0.7, adjust based on use case
parameters.tipsTopPDesc1: Use top_p for most cases (more stable)
parameters.tipsTopPDesc2: Use top_k when you need strict control
parameters.tipsTopPDesc3: Don't use both at max values simultaneously
parameters.tipsMaxTokensDesc1: Set based on expected response length
parameters.tipsSafetyDesc2: Adjust only if needed for your use case
parameters.temperatureDesc: Controls randomness. Lower = more deterministic, Higher = more creative
parameters.topPDesc: Nucleus sampling. Considers tokens with cumulative probability up to top_p
parameters.stopSequencesDesc: Array of strings that will stop generation
parameters.candidateCountDesc: Number of response variations to generate
parameters.blockOnlyHigh: Block only high probability harmful content
parameters.presencePenaltyDesc: Penalizes new tokens based on presence in text so far. Positive = encourage new topics
parameters.frequencyPenaltyDesc: Penalizes tokens based on frequency. Positive = reduce repetition
parameters.nDesc: Number of chat completion choices to generate
parameters.stopDesc: Up to 4 sequences where API will stop generating
parameters.logitBiasDesc: Modify likelihood of specified tokens appearing
parameters.responseFormatDesc: Force output format (GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-3.5 Turbo)

errors.title: AL API Gateway - Error Reference
errors.subtitle: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs
errors.overviewDesc: AL API Gateway follows RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs standard for all error responses. This provides a consistent, machine-readable format for error handling across all endpoints.
errors.usingTraceIdDesc: Every error response includes a trace_id field. This unique identifier can be used to:
errors.usingTraceIdCustom: You can also provide your own trace_id by sending it in the request header:
errors.debugModeDesc: In development/debug mode (APP_DEBUG=true), error responses include additional debug information:
errors.debugModeWarning: Warning: Debug mode should be disabled in production!
errors.bestPractice1: Always check status codes before parsing response
errors.bestPractice2: Log trace_id for all errors for easier debugging
errors.bestPractice3: Handle validation errors gracefully with user-friendly messages
errors.bestPractice4: Implement retry logic for 429 (rate limit) and 502 (provider errors)
errors.bestPractice5: Use Retry-After header value for exponential backoff
errors.authRequiredSolutionDesc: Include valid bearer token in Authorization header
errors.invalidApiKeyWhenDesc: Provided AI provider API key is invalid
errors.rateLimitExceededSolutionDesc: Wait for the specified retry_after period
errors.apiVersionUsed: API version used for the request
errors.secondsToWait: Seconds to wait before retry (429 only)
